creators.name: Niantic (John Hanke)
creators.role: Game studio; makers of Ingress, Pokémon GO and Peridot
creators.bio: Spun out of Google in 2015 under John Hanke, Niantic built the location-based AR games Ingress and Pokémon GO and the Lightship AR platform.
creators.why: Turned the whole planet into a shared game board and made phone AR a daily habit for hundreds of millions of players.

creators.name: 8th Wall (Erik Murphy-Chutorian)
creators.role: WebAR platform, acquired by Niantic in 2022
creators.bio: 8th Wall, founded by Erik Murphy-Chutorian in 2016, made markerless AR run in the mobile browser without an app and powered thousands of WebAR campaigns.
creators.why: Removed the app-install barrier so any link could open an AR world.

creators.name: Novarama
creators.role: Game studio; creators of Invizimals
creators.bio: Barcelona studio founded by Daniel Sánchez-Crespo that made the Invizimals series for PSP, PS Vita and PS3, which used a camera and marker trap card to capture creatures on the player's table.
creators.why: Invizimals (2009) was one of the first mass-market handheld AR games and made marker-based AR a playground hit a decade before ARKit.

creators.name: SCE London Studio
creators.role: Sony first-party studio (EyeToy, EyePet, Wonderbook)
creators.bio: Sony's London Studio pioneered camera games from EyeToy to EyePet and the Wonderbook, an AR book peripheral for PS3.
creators.why: Showed that a TV, a webcam and a printed card could make a believable virtual creature live in the living room.

creators.name: Nintendo
creators.role: Game and hardware company (3DS AR Games, Face Raiders)
creators.bio: Nintendo shipped AR Games and Face Raiders on every Nintendo 3DS in 2011, using AR cards and the handheld's cameras, and later co-created Mario Kart Live with Velan Studios.
creators.why: Put camera AR preinstalled in tens of millions of handhelds and kept finding playful uses for it.

creators.name: Velan Studios (Karthik & Guha Bala)
creators.role: Game studio; Mario Kart Live and Hot Wheels Rift Rally
creators.bio: Founded by brothers Karthik and Guha Bala, Velan Studios builds mixed-reality games that pair real RC cars with camera-based AR tracks.
creators.why: Mario Kart Live turned the player's living room into a racetrack seen from a real kart's camera.

creators.name: Google Creative Lab
creators.role: Google's in-house creative team (Experiments with Google)
creators.bio: Google Creative Lab makes open-source experiments that show new uses of Google tech, including a series of ARCore experiments such as Just a Line, Drawalong AR, Sounds in Space and Lines of Play.
creators.why: Produced some of the most shareable, open-source phone AR experiments, often with artists and dancers.

creators.name: Jonas Jongejan
creators.role: Creative technologist, Google Creative Lab
creators.bio: Danish creative technologist who built early ARCore experiments at Google Creative Lab and wrote the openFrameworks addon ofxARCore.
creators.why: His 2017 AR Wormhole and ARCore drawing prototypes helped set the playful tone of Google's AR experiments.

creators.name: Jeri Ellsworth
creators.role: Hardware engineer; co-founder of castAR and Tilt Five
creators.bio: Self-taught chip designer who built AR glasses at Valve, then spun them out as castAR (2013) and later Tilt Five, a retro-reflective tabletop AR game system.
creators.why: Two times she pushed a different idea of AR: glasses plus a retro-reflective board so shared holograms sit on a real table.

creators.name: Directive Games
creators.role: Game studio; The Machines (ARKit launch title)
creators.bio: Directive Games built The Machines, a tabletop multiplayer strategy game in Unreal Engine that Apple showed on stage when ARKit launched in 2017.
creators.why: The Machines was the first big demonstration of competitive multiplayer AR on a real table.

creators.name: Snap Inc. (Snapchat Lenses)
creators.role: Camera company; Snapchat Lenses and Lens Studio
creators.bio: Snap turned face filters into a mass medium with Snapchat Lenses (2015), then added World Lenses, Lens Studio for creators, Landmarkers and Local Lenses.
creators.why: Built the largest daily AR audience and opened it to independent lens artists.

creators.name: Ines Alpha
creators.role: 3D digital makeup artist
creators.bio: French artist who creates 3D 'e-makeup' that grows from faces as AR filters and face-tracked videos, working with musicians, fashion brands and Prada Beauty.
creators.why: Invented a new genre of surreal, non-human beauty made for the camera instead of the skin.

creators.name: Johanna Jaskowska
creators.role: AR designer; creator of Beauty3000
creators.bio: Polish designer whose Instagram effect Beauty3000 (2018), a glossy chrome face mask, went viral and helped launch the AR filter-artist scene.
creators.why: Beauty3000 reframed face filters as art about beauty and identity rather than puppy ears.

creators.name: Marc Wakefield
creators.role: AR effects artist; co-founder of Augmented Reality Design Studio
creators.bio: Illustrator turned AR artist whose Spark AR world effects and character filters have been used by millions, including work for U2; he runs Augmented Reality Design Studio with Susie Wakefield.
creators.why: One of the first illustrators to make a career of turning drawn worlds into Instagram AR.

creators.name: Paige Piskin
creators.role: AR filter creator (Snap Lens Studio, Spark AR)
creators.bio: Official Snap Lens Creator whose makeup, fashion and cartoon filters have been used billions of times; she also teaches lens making.
creators.why: Made AR makeup and cartoon-face lenses a pop medium and documents her process openly.

creators.name: Tonchidot (Takahito Iguchi)
creators.role: Startup; Sekai Camera AR app
creators.bio: Tonchidot, led by Takahito Iguchi, showed Sekai Camera at TechCrunch50 in 2008: an iPhone app that let people leave floating 'air tags' of text, photos and sound in places.
creators.why: Sekai Camera was one of the first social, location-anchored AR apps, years before AR clouds.

creators.name: Layar (Raimo van der Klein, Claire Boonstra, Maarten Lens-FitzGerald)
creators.role: Mobile AR browser company
creators.bio: Layar launched in 2009 as the first mobile AR browser, overlaying geolocated 'layers' of information on the camera view, and later moved to interactive print.
creators.why: Created the first open platform where anyone could publish geolocated AR content for phones.

creators.name: Otavio Good (Quest Visual)
creators.role: Creator of Word Lens
creators.bio: Otavio Good founded Quest Visual and built Word Lens (2010), which translated printed signs live in the camera view; Google acquired it for Google Translate.
creators.why: Word Lens was a 'magic' AR moment that replaced real-world text in place, on a 2010 iPhone.

creators.name: Within (Wonderscope)
creators.role: Immersive studio; Wonderscope AR stories for kids
creators.bio: Within, co-founded by Chris Milk and Aaron Koblin, made Wonderscope (2018), an iOS app of AR stories where children speak characters' lines aloud to move the story forward.
creators.why: Wonderscope made voice-driven AR storytelling for children, with the child as an actor inside the story.

creators.name: Climax Studios
creators.role: Game studio; ARise, Towers for Tango
creators.bio: UK developer that made early phone AR games for Google Tango and ARKit, including the perspective puzzle game ARise.
creators.why: ARise made the player's physical viewpoint the puzzle mechanic.

creators.name: Kunabi Brother
creators.role: Indie studio; Euclidean Lands
creators.bio: Small Viennese studio (Miro Straka) behind the rotating-cube puzzle game Euclidean Lands and one of the first ARKit ports.
creators.why: Brought a Monument Valley-style rotating puzzle onto the tabletop with ARKit on day one.

creators.name: Resolution Games
creators.role: XR game studio; Angry Birds AR: Isle of Pigs
creators.bio: Stockholm studio founded by Tommy Palm that makes VR, AR and mixed reality games, including Angry Birds AR: Isle of Pigs with Rovio.
creators.why: Isle of Pigs let players walk around a life-size structure on their floor to find its weak point.

creators.name: Mighty Coconut
creators.role: Game studio; 57° North (Merge Cube), Walkabout Mini Golf
creators.bio: Indie studio that made 57° North, a choose-your-own-adventure story played on the handheld Merge Cube, before its VR hit Walkabout Mini Golf.
creators.why: Turned a foam cube held in the hand into a tiny diorama stage for a branching story.

creators.name: Merge Labs (Merge Cube)
creators.role: AR/VR toy and education company
creators.bio: Merge makes the Merge Cube, a patterned foam cube that phones track so a hologram can be held and turned in the hand, used widely in schools.
creators.why: Made a cheap physical tracker that turns AR into something children can hold.

creators.name: Novum Analytics
creators.role: Indie studio; Night Terrors AR horror
creators.bio: Small studio behind Night Terrors, a crowdfunded phone AR survival horror game played at home in the dark with headphones.
creators.why: Night Terrors used the player's own house, mapped by the phone, as the haunted set.

creators.name: The LEGO Group (Hidden Side)
creators.role: Toy company; LEGO Hidden Side AR sets
creators.bio: LEGO's Hidden Side line (2019) combined physical building sets with a phone app that revealed ghosts haunting the model.
creators.why: Merged physical construction play with an AR layer that reacts to the built model.

creators.name: Mojang Studios (Minecraft Earth)
creators.role: Game studio; Minecraft Earth
creators.bio: Mojang and Microsoft built Minecraft Earth (2019–2021), a location-based AR game where players built life-size Minecraft structures in the real world.
creators.why: Let players build and play inside life-size voxel builds together on the street.

creators.name: Zenka (Zenka Caro)
creators.role: AR artist
creators.bio: Artist who from 2012 made AR street art, murals, postcards and linoleum prints that came alive through Aurasma on phones.
creators.why: An early fine-art user of phone AR, turning prints and walls into animated works years before ARKit.

creators.name: Tender Claws (Samantha Gorman & Danny Cannizzaro)
creators.role: Immersive game and art studio
creators.bio: Studio led by Samantha Gorman and Danny Cannizzaro that makes experimental VR and AR works such as Virtual Virtual Reality, The Under Presents and the AR pet TendAR.
creators.why: TendAR made an AR creature that literally feeds on the player's facial expressions and emotions.

creators.name: SCE Japan Studio (The Eye of Judgment)
creators.role: Sony first-party studio
creators.bio: Sony's Japan Studio co-created The Eye of Judgment (2007) with Wizards of the Coast, a PS3 card battle game read by the PlayStation Eye camera.
creators.why: The Eye of Judgment was the first major console AR game, turning a physical trading-card mat into a 3D battlefield.

works.title: Ingress
works.description: A location-based sci-fi game where two factions capture real-world landmarks as 'portals' by walking to them with a phone and link them into territory control fields.
works.idea_zh: 把真实城市地标变成两大阵营争夺的传送门，走路就是玩法。

works.title: Pokémon GO
works.description: Players walk their neighbourhood to find Pokémon that appear on the camera view over the real street, then throw Poké Balls to catch them; gyms and raids gather players at landmarks.
works.idea_zh: 让宝可梦出现在你家街角，用行走和相机去收集它们。

works.title: Pokémon GO AR+
works.description: An ARKit mode where Pokémon are anchored on the ground at real scale; walking closer can startle them, so players sneak up before throwing.
works.idea_zh: 宝可梦真实站在地面上，玩家要悄悄靠近才能捕捉。

works.title: Real World Platform Occlusion Demo (Pikachu & Eevee)
works.description: A research demo by Niantic and Matrix Mill in which Pikachu and Eevee run around a plaza and correctly disappear behind real people, planters and benches using learned depth.
works.idea_zh: 用深度学习让虚拟宝可梦被真实行人和物体遮挡，真正融入现实。

works.title: Codename: Neon
works.description: A real-time multiplayer AR laser-tag prototype: players in the same park shoot energy at each other, collect pellets and dodge shots that all players see in the same space.
works.idea_zh: 多人在同一片草地上看到同一场AR激光枪战，低延迟共享现实。

works.title: Codename: Tonehenge
works.description: A cooperative AR puzzle prototype in which several players standing around the same spot manipulate a shared virtual stone circle together in real time.
works.idea_zh: 几个人围在一起，共同操作同一个AR石阵来解谜。

works.title: Harry Potter: Wizards Unite
works.description: A location-based AR game with Warner Bros. where players trace spell glyphs on screen to free magical 'Foundables' that appear over the real world.
works.idea_zh: 在现实街道上画出咒语手势，解救散落在城市里的魔法物品。

works.title: Pokémon GO Buddy Adventure
works.description: Buddy Pokémon follow the player and can be viewed in AR, where players feed them, play with them and take snapshots; the bond grows as you walk together.
works.idea_zh: 把宝可梦变成陪你散步的AR伙伴，可以喂食、互动、合影。

works.title: Pokémon GO Shared AR Experience
works.description: Nearby trainers join one shared AR session in which their buddy Pokémon appear together in the same real-world scene, so friends can play and take photos together.
works.idea_zh: 附近的玩家进入同一个AR场景，看到彼此的伙伴宝可梦一起玩耍。

works.title: Pokémon GO AR Mapping
works.description: Players scan PokéStops and Gyms with their camera during field research tasks, producing 3D scans that build Niantic's map for persistent, location-anchored AR.
works.idea_zh: 玩家扫描现实地标，众包建起一张供AR使用的三维世界地图。

works.title: Pikmin Bloom
works.description: A walking game made with Nintendo: Pikmin sprout from your steps, follow you through the city and plant flowers along the path you walk, visible in AR.
works.idea_zh: 每走一步都在城市里种下花，皮克敏在AR里跟着你散步。

works.title: Peridot
works.description: An AR virtual pet game where each 'Dot' is a unique creature that understands the real ground, grass, water and sand around you and plays fetch or digs in them.
works.idea_zh: 一只能识别草地、水面和沙地的AR电子宠物，和真实环境玩耍。

works.title: Hello, Dot
works.description: A mixed-reality Peridot experience for Meta Quest 3 in which a Dot hatches in your room, recognises furniture and plays with you through passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 在头显的透视画面中，AR宠物在你房间里孵化并认识你的家具。

works.title: Peridot Beyond
works.description: Peridot on Snap Spectacles: several people wearing glasses see and play with the same Dots in shared multiplayer AR.
works.idea_zh: 戴上Spectacles，几个人一起在现实中照顾同一只AR宠物。

works.title: Monster Hunter Now Palico AR
works.description: In Monster Hunter Now, made with Capcom, the player's Palico cat companion can be placed in AR for photos alongside the monsters hunted in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把陪伴狩猎的艾露猫放进现实世界合影。

works.title: Lightship VPS for Web
works.description: 8th Wall and Niantic brought centimetre-level visual positioning to the mobile browser, so WebAR content can be anchored to specific real-world locations without an app.
works.idea_zh: 无需下载App，在浏览器里就能把AR内容精确锚定在真实地点。

works.title: Invizimals
works.description: A PSP game with a clip-on camera: players scan their surroundings to detect invisible creatures, then trap them on a printed marker card where they fight on the tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 用掌机摄像头在家里'捕捉'隐形怪兽，放在卡片上对战。

works.title: Invizimals: Shadow Zone
works.description: The sequel adds more creatures, new capture challenges and battles that play out around the camera-tracked trap card on the player's table.
works.idea_zh: 续作带来更多隐形生物和围绕陷阱卡的捕捉挑战。

works.title: Invizimals: The Lost Tribes
works.description: Third PSP entry with new tribes of Invizimals to hunt through the camera and battle on the marker trap card.
works.idea_zh: 用摄像头寻找新部族怪兽，并在卡片上对战。

works.title: Invizimals: The Alliance / The Lost Kingdom
works.description: PS Vita AR capture game (The Alliance) paired with a PS3 adventure (The Lost Kingdom) where creatures captured in AR travel between the handheld and the console world.
works.idea_zh: 在掌机上用AR捕获怪兽，再带着它们进入主机冒险世界。

works.title: EyePet
works.description: A virtual monkey-like pet appears on the living-room floor through the PlayStation Eye; players stroke, feed and wash it with their hands and draw toys on paper that it brings to life.
works.idea_zh: 一只会对你的手势做出反应的AR宠物，还能把你画在纸上的东西变成玩具。

works.title: EyePet (PlayStation Move edition)
works.description: EyePet updated for the PlayStation Move controller, which becomes tracked tools such as a hairdryer, shower head or paint brush in the pet's AR world.
works.idea_zh: 手里的Move手柄变成吹风机、画笔等AR工具，照顾宠物。

works.title: EyePet & Friends
works.description: Two players can each raise a pet that play together in the living room, with new costume, drawing and mini-game modes.
works.idea_zh: 两只AR宠物在你的客厅里一起玩耍。

works.title: Wonderbook: Book of Spells
works.description: Written with J.K. Rowling's Pottermore, a blank marker book becomes a pop-up spell book on screen; players wave the Move controller as a wand to cast spells that affect the pages and room.
works.idea_zh: 一本空白的实体书在屏幕里变成立体魔法书，用手柄当魔杖施咒。

works.title: Wonderbook: Book of Potions
works.description: A second Harry Potter Wonderbook where players brew potions in a virtual cauldron sitting on the book, grinding and pouring ingredients with the Move controller.
works.idea_zh: 在实体书上用手柄碾磨、倒入材料，调配AR魔药。

works.title: AR Games (Nintendo 3DS)
works.description: Preinstalled on every 3DS: placing a '?' AR card on a table makes a dragon burst out of it or lets you fish in a lake that opens in the table, shoot archery targets and draw graffiti.
works.idea_zh: 把一张AR卡片放在桌上，桌面就裂开成湖泊、跳出巨龙。

works.title: AR Games: Fishing
works.description: One of the 3DS AR Games modes: the table surface around the AR card turns into a pond, and the player fishes by moving and tilting the console.
works.idea_zh: 桌面在AR中化为池塘，移动掌机就能在自家桌上钓鱼。

works.title: Face Raiders
works.description: The 3DS takes a photo of your face (or a friend's) and turns it into flying enemy heads that attack through holes in your real room; you turn your body to aim and shoot.
works.idea_zh: 把你自己的脸变成敌人，从真实房间墙面破洞中飞出来攻击你。

works.title: Kid Icarus: Uprising AR Cards
works.description: Collectible AR cards for Kid Icarus: Uprising; placing two cards in front of the 3DS makes the characters appear and battle each other on the table.
works.idea_zh: 两张实体卡放在桌上，卡上的角色就跳出来对战。

works.title: Spirit Camera: The Cursed Memoir
works.description: A Fatal Frame spin-off co-developed with Koei Tecmo: the 3DS becomes the haunted Camera Obscura, and a bundled cursed diary reveals ghosts that appear in your real room.
works.idea_zh: 3DS变成一台能拍到鬼的相机，随附的日记本在AR中显出幽灵。

works.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit
works.description: A real RC kart with a camera drives around cardboard gates in your home; on the Switch, the camera feed becomes a Mario Kart track with items, rivals and weather overlaid on your rooms.
works.idea_zh: 一辆带摄像头的实体遥控卡丁车，把你家变成马力欧赛道。

works.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit — developer interview
works.description: Velan Studios explains how they built the kart, the gate-based track system and the latency-sensitive AR rendering that makes a living room feel like a race course.
works.idea_zh: 开发者讲述如何让真实车辆与虚拟赛道无缝融合。

works.title: Hot Wheels: Rift Rally
works.description: A smart RC car with a camera, controlled from a phone or console, races through gates at home while the screen overlays a Hot Wheels track, other racers and rift effects.
works.idea_zh: 用带摄像头的智能风火轮小车在家中竞速，屏幕里叠加赛道与对手。

works.title: Just a Line
works.description: A minimal ARCore/ARKit app for drawing a single white line in the air; two people on Android and iPhone can draw together in the same space, and the result is a shareable video.
works.idea_zh: 只画一条线的AR涂鸦App，而且安卓和iPhone可以同场一起画。

works.title: Just a Line with Shantell Martin
works.description: Artist Shantell Martin extends her signature continuous black-line drawings into the air around her using Just a Line.
works.idea_zh: 艺术家把标志性的连续线条从墙面画进空气里。

works.title: AR Experiments (ARCore launch collection)
works.description: A collection of small open-source ARCore prototypes released at launch, from drawing and physics toys to portals, showing creative uses of the new platform.
works.idea_zh: ARCore发布时的一组开源小实验，展示AR的各种创意可能。

works.title: Drawalong AR
works.description: Turns a YouTube drawing tutorial into virtual tracing paper: the video floats over your real sketchbook so you can trace along. Made with YouTube artist AmandaRachLee.
works.idea_zh: 把YouTube绘画教程变成浮在真实画本上的描图纸。

works.title: D.I.S.P.L.A.Y.E.D + Audio AR
works.description: Heidi Latsky Dance and Google Creative Lab added position-based audio AR to a living-sculpture dance performance, so visitors hear dancers' voices and stories as they walk up to each performer.
works.idea_zh: 观众走近舞者时，耳中响起专属于该舞者的空间声音叙事。

works.title: Sounds in Space
works.description: An open-source toolkit for curating location-based audio in a room: sounds are placed in space and the phone plays a soundtrack that changes as the visitor walks.
works.idea_zh: 把声音放进空间里，随着你走动而变化的AR声景。

works.title: Lines of Play
works.description: Build domino chains on real floors and furniture; with the ARCore Depth API the dominoes hide behind real obstacles, collide with real objects and topple with spatial audio.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地面摆AR多米诺骨牌，它们会被真实物体遮挡并撞到真实物体。

works.title: AR Wormhole
works.description: A thought experiment about stepping into the past: a live 360 camera streams to the phone with a 10-second delay, and walking through a portal lets you look around the moment that just happened.
works.idea_zh: 穿过一个虫洞，回到10秒前的现实并环顾四周。

works.title: ARCore Drawing (ofxARCore)
works.description: A simple demo for drawing 3D lines in space on an Android phone, made to show how openFrameworks and ARCore combine; the code became the ofxARCore addon.
works.idea_zh: 用openFrameworks和ARCore在空中画三维线条的开源示例。

works.title: castAR Kickstarter
works.description: Glasses with tiny projectors that bounce light off a retro-reflective mat, so each wearer sees their own correct-perspective 3D holograms, such as board games, on the table.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜里的微型投影仪打到反光板上，让每个人看到桌面上的立体全息游戏。

works.title: castAR at Maker Faire 2013
works.description: Jeri Ellsworth demonstrates the castAR glasses and wand, explaining how the technology she started at Valve tracks the head and projects stereo images onto the mat.
works.idea_zh: 展示从Valve带出来的AR眼镜和魔杖原型。

works.title: castAR SmartGlasses at AWE 2015
works.description: A later castAR prototype shown at AWE 2015 with tabletop games that several players see at once around the retro-reflective surface.
works.idea_zh: 多人围坐反光桌面，共同玩全息桌游。

works.title: Tilt Five Holographic Game System
works.description: The Tilt Five Kickstarter: lightweight glasses and a retro-reflective game board plus a wand controller, so friends around a table share holographic board and video games.
works.idea_zh: 一块反光游戏板和一副眼镜，让朋友们围桌共享全息桌游。

works.title: Tilt Five — Gaming with Tabletop Holograms
works.description: Shipping Tilt Five games shown through the glasses: tabletop strategy, board games and toys that rise from the board and respond to the wand.
works.idea_zh: 游戏从桌面板上立起来，用魔杖直接操控全息棋子。

works.title: The Machines (Apple keynote reveal)
works.description: Shown at Apple's iPhone 8 event: a tabletop strategy battle in which players walk around the table to change the view and find openings in the enemy base.
works.idea_zh: 绕着桌子走动去观察战场，身体移动本身就是战术。

works.title: The Machines
works.description: The released game: 1v1 real-time multiplayer battles on a real table, where each phone is a moving camera over a shared miniature battlefield.
works.idea_zh: 两台手机在同一张桌上共享微缩战场，实时对战。

works.title: Snapchat World Lenses
works.description: Snapchat's rear-camera lenses place animated 3D objects, such as a rainbow-puking cloud or the Dancing Hot Dog, on the ground in the real scene that users can walk around and record.
works.idea_zh: 把动画3D角色放进后置镜头的真实世界，让AR成为全民表情包。

works.title: Jeff Koons x Snapchat
works.description: Geolocated AR versions of Jeff Koons sculptures such as Balloon Dog appeared at sites like Central Park and the Champ de Mars, visible only through a Snapchat lens at those places.
works.idea_zh: 把杰夫·昆斯的雕塑以AR形式'安放'在全球著名地点。

works.title: Landmarkers
works.description: Lenses that recognise famous buildings such as the Eiffel Tower or Flatiron Building and transform their real facades with animation, e.g. making the structure melt or burst into rainbows.
works.idea_zh: 识别真实地标建筑，让整座埃菲尔铁塔在镜头里变形、融化、喷彩虹。

works.title: Local Lenses
works.description: Persistent, shared AR that covers entire city blocks: multiple Snapchatters can paint and decorate real building facades together, and the changes stay in place for others.
works.idea_zh: 多人一起给整条街道的真实建筑涂装，AR内容会持久留在原地。

works.title: Future Gloss
works.description: Ines Alpha's first Snapchat lens: glossy, liquid 3D makeup that drips and flows over the user's face in real time.
works.idea_zh: 液态光泽的3D妆容在脸上实时流动，化妆不再受物理限制。

works.title: ines alpha x Katsu
works.description: A face-tracked 3D makeup look made with artist Katsu: iridescent sculptural forms grow from and cling to the face as it moves.
works.idea_zh: 为艺术家量身打造的三维数字妆容，贴合面部动态生长。

works.title: ines alpha x The Bulletproof Cat
works.description: Another face-tracked 3D makeup collaboration in which translucent, organic 3D shapes sit on and move with a performer's face.
works.idea_zh: 半透明的有机形态附着在脸上，随表情一起运动。

works.title: Bimba y Lola x Ines Alpha filter
works.description: An Instagram face filter for the Bimba y Lola Fall/Winter 2019 collection that covers the face in Alpha's glossy sculptural 3D makeup.
works.idea_zh: 把品牌时装季的视觉变成人人可戴的3D数字妆容滤镜。

works.title: Prada Beauty 'Rethinking Beauty' AR filter
works.description: As Prada Beauty's Global Creative E-Makeup Artist, Alpha designed a three-mode Instagram AR filter with FFFACE.ME that layers futuristic e-makeup on the user's face.
works.idea_zh: 为奢侈品美妆设计的三种模式数字妆容滤镜。

works.title: Beauty3000
works.description: An Instagram face effect that coats the face in a shiny, iridescent plastic-like skin that catches light as you move; it went viral in 2018 and helped start the AR filter-artist movement.
works.idea_zh: 把脸变成闪亮塑料般的未来皮肤，追问'什么是美'。

works.title: Spark AR world effects
works.description: Marc Wakefield turns his drawn and painted characters and worlds into Instagram world effects that place them into the user's surroundings, including effects for U2.
works.idea_zh: 把手绘角色和奇幻世界变成可以放进现实的Instagram AR效果。

works.title: Lil Cartoon Bratz Doll
works.description: A Snapchat lens that turns the user's face into a big-eyed, glossy-lipped 90s fashion-doll cartoon, inspired by Piskin's favourite childhood toy.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸实时变成90年代时尚娃娃的卡通模样。

works.title: Coachella 'MetaButterfly' filter
works.description: An Instagram AR effect for a Coachella campaign with butterfly-themed makeup effects on the face; Piskin walks through the inspiration, makeup and tech.
works.idea_zh: 为音乐节设计的蝴蝶幻彩妆容与翅膀AR滤镜。

works.title: Coachella 'Luminous' filter
works.description: A glowing, light-reactive face effect created for Coachella on Instagram, with behind-the-scenes on the makeup design and technical build.
works.idea_zh: 音乐节主题的发光妆容滤镜，让脸像舞台灯一样闪耀。

works.title: Sekai Camera (TechCrunch50 demo)
works.description: The TechCrunch50 demo of Sekai Camera: point an iPhone at a street or shop and see floating 'air tags' left by other people, with notes, photos and voice memos attached to places.
works.idea_zh: 让人们把文字、照片和声音像气泡一样'留'在真实地点。

works.title: Sekai Camera science museum navigation
works.description: Sekai Camera air tags used as a guide inside a science museum, pointing visitors to exhibits through the camera view.
works.idea_zh: 用空中标签在科学馆里为参观者导航。

works.title: Sekai Camera for iPad
works.description: Sekai Camera on the iPad: the larger screen becomes a window onto the air-tag layer around the user.
works.idea_zh: 把iPad变成看见城市中'空中标签'的大窗口。

works.title: Layar Reality Browser
works.description: The first mobile AR browser: on an Android phone, the camera view shows geolocated layers of nearby homes for sale, restaurants, ATMs and more, published by anyone through an open API.
works.idea_zh: 世界上第一个手机AR浏览器，把各种地理信息图层叠加在相机画面上。

works.title: Layar for Google Glass
works.description: Layar's image-recognition AR ported to Google Glass, so printed pages and posters trigger interactive content in the wearer's view.
works.idea_zh: 把印刷品识别AR带到Google眼镜上。

works.title: Word Lens
works.description: Point an iPhone at a sign or menu and the printed Spanish or English text is replaced in place, in the same style, with its translation, running offline in real time.
works.idea_zh: 对准外语招牌，文字当场被替换成母语，像魔法一样。

works.title: Word Lens for Glass
works.description: Word Lens on Google Glass: the wearer looks at a sign and sees it translated in their view hands-free.
works.idea_zh: 戴上眼镜看招牌，翻译直接出现在视野里。

works.title: Wonderscope
works.description: An iOS app of AR stories for children: characters appear life-size in the room and the child moves the story along by walking around and reading lines out loud to them.
works.idea_zh: 孩子朗读台词推动故事，AR角色就在客厅里回应。

works.title: Clio's Cosmic Quest
works.description: A space-adventure story on Wonderscope staged life-size in the child's room; like all Wonderscope stories, the child advances it by reading characters' lines aloud.
works.idea_zh: 在自己房间里展开一场需要开口对话的太空冒险。

works.title: Wonder's Land: Ringmaster Wanted!
works.description: A circus-themed Wonderscope story that plays out around the child, who takes part by speaking lines aloud to the performers.
works.idea_zh: 孩子加入一场AR马戏团演出，用声音参与表演。

works.title: Willowcrest Manor
works.description: A Wonderscope mystery set in a spooky mansion that unfolds around the child's room.
works.idea_zh: 一座神秘庄园在孩子的房间里展开推理故事。

works.title: Sinclair Snake
works.description: A Wonderscope story centred on a snake character, told in AR scenes around the child's home and advanced by speaking aloud.
works.idea_zh: 和一条AR小蛇对话，用声音推动故事。

works.title: ARise
works.description: A puzzle game where the player never touches the hero: you physically move and tilt your phone around a tabletop world until the paths line up from the right perspective.
works.idea_zh: 不用触屏，靠绕着桌子移动视角让路径对齐来解谜。

works.title: Towers for Tango
works.description: A tower-defence game for Google's Tango depth-sensing phones in which the battlefield and towers are placed on real floors and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 在深度感知手机上，把塔防战场放在真实的地板和家具上。

works.title: Euclidean Lands AR
works.description: A turn-based puzzle game on a rotating cube world, adapted for ARKit so the Rubik's-cube-like diorama sits on the player's table and can be walked around.
works.idea_zh: 把魔方般旋转的解谜小世界放在桌面上，绕着它思考。

works.title: Angry Birds AR: Isle of Pigs
works.description: Pig fortresses are built on the player's floor at room scale; players walk around them to find weak points and then launch birds from a slingshot.
works.idea_zh: 把愤怒的小鸟城堡搭在你家地板上，绕着走一圈寻找弱点。

works.title: 57° North
works.description: A choose-your-own-adventure story played on the Merge Cube: each chapter appears as a small diorama in the palm that the player turns and chooses within.
works.idea_zh: 把分支叙事故事装进手掌中的立方体小剧场。

works.title: Merge Cube
works.description: A patterned foam cube that a phone camera tracks, so a hologram such as a planet, skull or artefact appears in the user's hand and can be turned and examined.
works.idea_zh: 一个泡沫方块，让孩子把全息物体真正'拿'在手里。

works.title: Night Terrors
works.description: A survival horror game played at home in the dark with headphones: the phone becomes the only way to see the monsters and apparitions that move through your own rooms.
works.idea_zh: 关灯戴耳机，自己家变成怪物出没的恐怖游戏场景。

works.title: Night Terrors: Bloody Mary
works.description: A follow-up that brings the Bloody Mary legend into the player's home, with the ghost stalking them through the phone's AR view.
works.idea_zh: 把血腥玛丽传说带进你家，鬼魂在AR中跟踪你。

works.title: LEGO Hidden Side
works.description: Physical LEGO sets such as a haunted school or graveyard are scanned by a phone app that reveals ghosts inside the model; players hunt them by moving around the build.
works.idea_zh: 拼好实体乐高，再用手机透视出藏在模型里的鬼魂。

works.title: Minecraft Earth
works.description: Players collect blocks around their neighbourhood, build on tabletop 'build plates', then place builds at life size in the real world and play in them together.
works.idea_zh: 把我的世界的方块建筑以真实尺寸放在街头，大家一起进入。

works.title: Augmented Reality Street Art
works.description: Wheat-pasted street art by Zenka that, seen through an AR app, animates on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 街头贴画在手机里动起来。

works.title: Space Mural (Aurasma)
works.description: A painted space-themed mural that triggers animated AR content through Aurasma when viewed with a phone.
works.idea_zh: 一幅太空壁画在手机镜头下变成动态影像。

works.title: Augmented Reality Linoleum Prints
works.description: Hand-carved linoleum prints that come alive with animation when scanned, joining traditional printmaking with AR.
works.idea_zh: 传统版画与AR结合，手刻版画在镜头里活过来。

works.title: Reality Fighters
works.description: A PS Vita launch title in which players put their own photographed face on a fighter and brawl in AR on their real surroundings, filmed by the Vita's rear camera.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的脸贴到格斗角色上，在真实街道或客厅里AR对打。

works.title: TendAR
works.description: An ARCore pet game where a talking guppy fish lives in the camera view and feeds on the player's emotions, read from their facial expressions, and asks them to show objects around them.
works.idea_zh: 一条以你的表情和情绪为食的AR小鱼。

works.title: The Eye of Judgment
works.description: Physical trading cards laid on a 3x3 mat are read by the PlayStation Eye, and the creatures on them rise up as animated 3D monsters that fight on the TV image of the table.
works.idea_zh: 把实体卡牌对战升级：卡片上的怪兽在电视里的桌面上立体现身开战。

works.title: Pokémon GO Snapshot
works.description: An AR photo mode where players place their Pokémon in the real world, approach and pose it, and take pictures; wild Pokémon sometimes photobomb the shot.
works.idea_zh: 在现实中给宝可梦拍写真，偶尔还会有野生宝可梦乱入。

works.title: 8th Wall Sizzle Reel 2023
works.description: A showcase of WebAR projects built by agencies and creators on 8th Wall: face effects, portals, world tracking and image targets that open from a link in the phone browser.
works.idea_zh: 一段合集，展示无需App、点链接就能打开的各种网页AR作品。

works.title: Microsoft Mixed Reality Capture holograms in WebAR
works.description: Volumetric video of real performers captured in Microsoft's Mixed Reality Capture Studios plays as life-size holograms in the phone browser through 8th Wall.
works.idea_zh: 真人全息视频直接在手机浏览器里以真人大小出现在你面前。

leads.name: Clay Weishaar (@wabisabi / Fake Artists)
leads.why: Influential Spark AR / Lens creator and founder of Fake Artists studio; works live mostly on Instagram, no verified video found this round.

leads.name: Aidan Wolf
leads.why: Snap AR developer known for Spectacles 'downloadable theme park' lenses; belongs to headset/Spectacles batch.

leads.name: Phil Walton
leads.why: Official Snap Lens Creator behind the viral 'Potato Boss' lens and author of The Designer's Guide to Snapchat's Lens Studio.

leads.name: Ommy Akhe
leads.why: AR creative strategist and lens creator (WIRED Smarter talk on AR retail).

leads.name: Don Allen III
leads.why: Meta Spark / Lens creator and educator (DAQRI-era AR evangelist).

leads.name: Luke Hurd
leads.why: Early Spark AR and Lens Studio educator; custom Landmarker experiments (Charlie Parker memorial).

leads.name: Andrew Mendez
leads.why: Early Lens Studio creator featured in Snap creator spotlight (2017).

leads.name: Anrick Bregman (AN/RK)
leads.why: Snap creator and director who spoke on making AR in Lens Studio at AWE.

leads.name: Nancy Baker Cahill (4th Wall)
leads.why: Artist making geolocated AR public art via her 4th Wall app; belongs to artists batch.

leads.name: Zach Lieberman & Molmol Kuo — Weird Cuts (Google Arts & Culture, 2019)
leads.why: AR collage app made with Google Arts & Culture; verified video kpj4J8RrYwQ. Belongs to Zach Lieberman batch.

leads.name: Liquid City / Keiichi Matsuda — Wol (8th Wall, 2023)
leads.why: WebAR mixed-reality piece built on 8th Wall; verified video GUgAw-uU46o. Belongs to artists batch.

leads.name: Wingnut AR (Peter Jackson)
leads.why: Showed the WWDC 2017 ARKit tabletop battle demo and later Dr. Grordbort's Invaders on Magic Leap.

leads.name: Julian Oliver — levelHead (2007)
leads.why: Tangible AR cube game using marker tracking; also The Artvertiser. Artist/critical engineer.

leads.name: Ori Inbar (Ogmento, AWE, Auggie Awards)
leads.why: Co-founded early AR games company Ogmento (2009) and the AWE conference / Auggie Awards.

leads.name: Georgia Tech Augmented Environments Lab — ARhrrrr! (2009)
leads.why: Early phone AR zombie shooter on a printed city map; belongs to HCI labs batch.

leads.name: Sander Veenhof & Mark Skwarek — We AR in MoMA (2010)
leads.why: Unauthorised AR art intervention in MoMA using the Layar browser.

leads.name: Supermassive Games — Wonderbook: Walking with Dinosaurs (2013)
leads.why: BBC Wonderbook AR title; verified video -XQ4EJjyVXI.

leads.name: Moonbot Studios — Wonderbook: Diggs Nightcrawler (2013)
leads.why: Wonderbook AR detective story by the studio of 'The Fantastic Flying Books of Mr. Morris Lessmore'.

leads.name: Koei Tecmo (Spirit Camera co-developer)
leads.why: Fatal Frame team; co-developed the 3DS AR horror game Spirit Camera.

leads.name: Zappar (Caspar Thykier)
leads.why: UK WebAR/ZapWorks platform behind many packaging and museum AR campaigns.

leads.name: Metaio / Junaio
leads.why: German AR SDK and browser company (acquired by Apple 2015) that powered much pre-ARKit phone AR.

leads.name: Claire Boonstra
leads.why: Layar co-founder; later focused on AR in education and interactive print.
